bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/save_sync.rs (SyncedDirectory, SaveError, ERROR_DOMAIN) and springboard/ui/src/save_sync.rs (State, Version, resolve_conflicts, newest); springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs and springboard/sdk/src/restoration.rs (per-app data directory only); springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs (advisory locks); no cloud save sync in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/apps/games-desktop/
summary: GameSave syncs an app's save files through iCloud Drive with conflict resolution, offline play and alerts. BifrOSt now has a local save directory API (open, state, read and write, close) with the same state and conflict model, but no sync engine: every directory is local, so the cloud states never occur, and the bifrost-cloud backend is not reached from the SDK.

features.note: open creates <data>/saves/<container> and state reports Local or Closed. No cloud container exists, so Ready, Offline, Syncing and Conflicted never occur.

features.feature: Syncing a directory and progress UI
features.apple: finishSyncing(), finishSyncing(statusDisplay:) with modal progress alert
features.note: finish_syncing returns at once because there is no sync to wait for. No progress alert and no sync engine. The shell's backup code (springboard/src/shell/backup.rs) covers only the shell's own data, not app directories.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/save_sync.rs (Version, resolve_conflicts, newest); springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs (advisory flock on the parent directory)
features.note: The model settles a conflict between given versions and picks the newest one. Nothing produces cloud versions, so a real conflict never reaches it. file_coordination has no versions.
The call exists and reports zero uploads started, since there is no upload queue. Files are only written to local disk.

features.apple: Local saving when the device is not signed into iCloud Drive (GameSave overview)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/save_sync.rs (SyncedDirectory::write_file, read_file); springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, springboard/sdk/src/restoration.rs (FILE in the app data directory)
features.note: Local saving works without any account, with atomic writes and a fingerprint of the contents. The save is not synced, so this matches only the offline half of the feature.
The domain name and a SaveError enum for invalid containers and names, closed directories and file errors. No sync errors exist yet.
Objective-C-only name for the same class; BifrOSt apps are Rust.

features.feature: Cloud account backup of user data
features.apple: Not part of GameSave; nearest Apple counterpart is iCloud Drive
features.bifrost: ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud/docs/schema.md (device_backups, encrypted backups of a BifrOSt PC); ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud/skill/SKILL.md (backups timer)
features.note: Account-level encrypted device backups exist in the cloud backend, but the PC client code that uploads them was not found in bifrost-os, and no app can reach its save directory through them. Counted as partial background only, not as GameSave parity.

gaps: Cloud sync engine behind the save directory (containers, background sync, Ready, Offline and Syncing states)
Version history on disk and cloud versions, so that a real conflict can arise and be resolved
Sync status UI and the upload trigger (progress alert, pending upload queue)
Mapping of per-app save directories into bifrost-cloud backups (no SDK or client path exists)
